title: AW27 Boys' Show Jumper
summary: Sport colour blocking and stripes from show jumping: technical knits, track jackets and padded gilets.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-fair forecast. The AW27 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime Paris) take place in January 2027. This report applies the 2026 adult yarn, fabric and leather fair evidence and the AW26 kidswear fair record to kidswear, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Pitti Filati's AW27 research theme "Discipline" draws on dressage, Western reining (Quarter Horse spots, quilt geometry, denim, suede, flannel) and show jumping (stripes, colour blocking, technical knits) <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Colour-block track jacket.
- Padded gilet.
- Striped knit.

design_implications: - Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
